name: touch-speaker
description: Ditado por voz para Windows: segure uma tecla, fale e o texto aparece no cursor.
author: Victor Alves

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.main.json && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json && tsc -p tsconfig.main-window.json && node scripts/copy-static.mjs
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.main.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.main-window.json --noEmit
scripts.dist:win: npm run clean && npm run build && electron-builder --win --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:mac: npm run clean && npm run build && electron-builder --mac --arm64 --publish never
